home.hero_subtitle: Report civic problems like potholes, garbage piles, broken lights, and water leaks directly to the right municipal authority using AI.
home.step1_desc: Provide details, location, and an optional photo in your own language. No login required.
home.step2_desc: Google Gemini categorizes the issue, determines urgency, and routes it directly to the responsible municipal department.
home.step3_desc: Follow public issue progress from submission to resolution in real time.

report.page_subtitle: Easy and fast. No account or password needed.
report.title_placeholder: e.g., Large pothole near the bus stop
report.desc_placeholder: Describe what is happening, exact location hints, or safety concerns...
report.photo_help: Photos are automatically compressed to ensure fast upload.
report.success_desc: Your issue has been recorded and analyzed by AI.
report.manual_review_notice: Notice: Automated AI classification was temporarily unavailable; your issue is safely recorded and queued for priority manual review by municipal staff.

track.page_subtitle: Check the real-time resolution progress of any submitted civic issue.
track.not_found: No complaint was found matching this tracking ID. Please verify and try again.

issues.page_subtitle: View public reports and follow municipal resolution progress across the city.
issues.search_placeholder: Search by neighborhood, street or keyword...
issues.no_issues: No complaints found matching the selected criteria.

admin.placeholder_title: Authority Portal - Coming in Upcoming Stage
admin.placeholder_desc: The admin authentication, issue triaging, priority overrides, and resolution status management will be activated in the upcoming stage.

errors.desc_required: Please provide a description of the issue.
errors.location_required: Please specify the location or landmark.
errors.gps_failed: Unable to retrieve your location. Please enter it manually.
errors.network_error: Connection issue. Please check your internet connection and try again.
errors.gps_denied: Location permission was denied. Please type your address manually.
errors.photo_too_large: Image could not be compressed under 500 KB. Please select a smaller photo.

footer.about: CivicResolve is an open public civic issue management initiative.
footer.built_with: Built with Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Google Gemini AI.
